hero.description:
Full-Stack Developer.
Next.js • Spring Boot • MongoDB • Docker
Based in Egypt.
Building web apps & APIs.

list.title: Arch Studio
list.subtitle: (Freelance Project)
list.description: A responsive portfolio site for showcasing architectural design work. Serves as a performance focused frontend implementation using lazy loaded image trails with cms.

list.title: Movie Intelligence App
list.subtitle: (4-Person Team Project • ITI Internship)
list.description: Cinematic platform featuring Firebase authentication, global state management, and an advanced IMDB-style rating algorithm.

list.title: Knowledge Archive
list.description: A Renaissance-inspired interactive learning archive exploring the Spring Boot ecosystem hierarchy, directory blueprints, and Web MVC request lifecycles through clean visual reference guides.

list.title: Vanilla JS E-Commerce
list.subtitle: (5-Person Team Project • ITI Internship)
list.description:
- Built a full e-commerce platform featuring cart functionality, checkout flows, and user authentication.
- Implemented a dedicated admin dashboard for managing catalog items and order data using pure JavaScript.

list.title: Bento Games Tracker
list.description: Bento-styled game completion board designed for focused gamers. Built with the latest Next.js App Router and integrated with Google Gemini for intelligent achievement roadmaps.

list.title: 3D Web
list.description: A vertical storytelling experience exploring 7 approaches to 3D rendering. Serves as a technical reference for WebGL pipelines, Spline, Globe.gl, and CSS trigonometry.

list.title: Verdant Plants Store
list.description: Fully functional e-commerce boutique powered by WordPress and WooCommerce.

list.title: Lead Scraper
list.description: An automated n8n workflow orchestrating a Python/Flask microservice. It scrapes daily job postings, leverages an LLM to summarize requirements, and delivers insights via email.

list.title: BearBuzz
list.description: Automated financial monitoring engine featuring dual desktop and terminal interfaces to track stock price volatility, aggregate breaking headlines, and deliver instant text alert notifications to mobile phones.

list.title: CLI Expense Tracker
list.description: A CLI personal finance manager written in C featuring manual dynamic memory management, binary file storage, and a custom recursive QuickSort.

about.eduDesc: Specialized in accounting and project management, which strengthened my problem-solving skills and gave me a solid understanding of real-world product needs.
about.notOnline: MERN Stack certificate is not online yet.
about.bioP1: My journey began with Python automation and scripting, building tools to scrape data and automate tasks. I then expanded into full-stack development, mastering the MERN stack to engineer dynamic applications.
about.bioP2: Today, I focus on building complete, containerized applications using Docker, ensuring that what runs on my machine runs everywhere.
about.bioP3: When I'm not coding, you can find me exploring retro tech, playing classic games, or experimenting with 3D web graphics.
